verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a cloud platform, but the evidence pack has no documented general event-to-action rules engine. Event Grid, Logic Apps, Functions triggers and alert action groups are all absent. The only nearby items are cost budget alerts (azure-docs-13) and outage notifications (azure-docs-18). These are narrow notification features, not user-defined rules that trigger arbitrary actions, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
